options.rationale: Wrong: you wait for the operator or police.

options.text: Move the car off the tracks yourself first
options.rationale: Wrong: you wait for directions.

options.text: Wait for the operator or the police to tell you what to do
options.rationale: If your vehicle touches a streetcar or train, wait for the operator or the police to direct you.

options.text: Exchange insurance and leave
options.rationale: Wrong: you wait for the operator or police.

items.correct_rationale: Option C is correct: if your vehicle touches a streetcar or train, wait for the operator or the police to direct you.
distractor_source: synthesized near-miss: you wait for the operator or police.
